panel_reliability.coverage_basis: freshest session stocks used over stocks total, as published
panel_reliability.form: reliability = panel_stability * coverage / (1 + abs(panel_drift_z)); panel derived inputs are discounted by the reliability
panel_reliability.note: The combined aggregate is published raw, not discounted, while its panel reliability is not recorded. Per session coverage snapshots are recorded in panel-history.json from this refresh on, so the drift series the form needs can be built.
panel_reliability.stability_basis: one minus the coverage range across the sessions on record
